t: Prosecution Against Two Chinese Students For Publishing Indecent Articles In A Weekly Magazine Entitled Yin Hu News Movie & Dancing News

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
No. S. 5
S. 5 Special Branch.
REPORT
Date. December 12, 19 35.
Subject: Prosecution against two Chinese students for publishing indecent articles in a weekly magazine entitled "Yin Hu News" (影舞新聞) (Movie & Dancing News).
Made/by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

Sir,
Zau Ts Nga (趙子昂) and Tseu Wei Lien (鄒威廉),
joint publishers of a weekly magazine entitled "Movie &
Dancing News", who were proceeded against on summons
under Article 235, Section 1, of the Chinese Criminal Code
for publishing indecent articles in their publication on
November 18 and 26, appeared before the 1st Special
District Court on December 12, when they were fined $150
each.
The accused gave notice of appeal.

Gkmoore
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch)

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
commented on by investigating officer).

On 6/11/35, C.D.S. 96, attached to S5, purchased
from an unknown street newsvendor on Shantung Road,
two copies of a periodical entitled "Movie and Dancing
News". One of the magazines published on 18/11/35
contained an article in indecent language regarding
two females addicted to sexual acts of a perverted
nature, while the other, published on 26/11/35,
contained a poem about a prostitute who married a
sadist. Copies of both articles are attached.

The above publications were printed by the Wei
San (匯山) Printing Company, 42 Yoo Choh Rd., 陽春里
Tseuhwan Road, and bore the names of the two accused
described on Sheet No. 1, as joint publishers. Both
the accused are students in St. John's University.

Summons against the two accused were applied
for by S.I. Horn. 1/9 35, and same were received on
10/12/35. They were brought to this station by D.P.S.
Lockwood and C.D.S. 96 at 3-30 p.m. on 10/12/35, and
were arrested at 4 p.m. same date by C.D.S. 96 and
C.D.C. 205.

A charge of publishing indecent articles, contrary
to Article 235 (1) of the C.C.R.C., has been preferred
against the two accused. The case is set for hearing
at 9 a.m. on 12/12/35.

上述出版物由汇山（Wei San）印刷公司印制，地址为虬江路阳春里42号（原文地址表述有误，结合上下文应为同山路颐业里，此处保留原文地名音译差异），并载有第1页所述两名被告作为联合出版人的姓名。两名被告均为圣约翰大学的学生。

霍恩（Horn）巡佐于1935年12月1日申请对两名被告发出传票，并于1935年12月10日收到传票。1935年12月10日下午3:30，洛克伍德（Lockwood）副总巡和96号华籍侦探将二人带至本巡捕房，并于当日下午4:00由96号华籍侦探和205号华籍总巡将其逮捕。

已依据《中华民国刑法》第235条第(1)款，以出版淫秽文章罪对两名被告提起诉讼。案件定于1935年12月12日上午9时审理。

REPORT
Date December 3, 1935.
Subject Anonymous letter re. indecent article appearing in the "Yin Hu News" (Movie & Dancing News), a weekly periodical.
Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Moore.

Sir,
With reference to the anonymous letter on file dated November 25, relating to an indecent article which appeared in the "Yin Hu News" (影舞新聞) (Movie & Dancing News), a translation of the article referred to, marked "A" and a further article from the same publication, marked "B", is submitted attached.

The language used in these articles appear to be definitely indecent, and a contravention of Article 235, Section 1, of the Chinese Criminal Code.

The "Yin Hu News" (Movie & Dancing News) is published by two students named Zau Ts Nga (趙子昂) and Tseu Wei Lien (鄒威廉) of St. John's University.

The first issue appeared in August 1935, and approximately 2,000 copies are printed each issue. The printing is done by the Wei San Printing Company (匯山印務局), No. 42 Yee Loh Li (頤樂里), Tongshan Road.

The publication in question is not registered with the Chinese Authorities, although an application for same has been submitted to the Shanghai City Government.

D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch) S5
Please arrange to prosecute.
8 DEC. 1935

"A"
The Movie & Dancing News (影舞新聞), a weekly
periodical, published the following article on November 18, 1935:-

There is a certain young and exceedingly beautiful
lady who goes by the name of Ah Kiu (阿九) living in an
alley off Swatow Road. This girl has a craving for
"knowledge" of persons of her own sex and this is her one
joy in life. She has no use for the Banana or Jinseng
(penis), never bothering about how it feels, and caring
no more for it than she does for a pair of straw slippers.
In the next house to Ah Kiu there also lives another
dissolute girl named Lou San (老三), who is a connoisseur
in sexual intercourse, but she also does not enjoy the
opposite sex. Since these two girls have become acquainted,
they associate so closely with each other that they are
like husband and wife. These two girls on various
occasions will hire a room in a hotel and hold a debauch
between themselves, when they battle together. They use
daggers and knives (imitation penises) in their battles,
and all sorts of these are supplied by Ah Kiu. They get
so thrilled during their "fighting" that they do not stop
until they are utterly exhausted.

One day a certain girl went to call on one of them
on a matter of business and when she went in and opened
the bedroom door there they were both lying naked in the
throes of a "battle". Their hair was all dishevelled and
their bodies were all splashed with "fluid", while they
kept crying out "Happiness, Happiness" incessantly. The
two girls had reached the gasping stage when the guest
came in, and so although they saw her they could no longer
stop. The guest withdrew at once, but she had seen this
secret act of indecency quite clearly.

The above information was provided by the girl

周刊《影舞新闻》于1935年11月18日发表了以下文章：

有一位名叫阿九的年轻貌美女士，住在汕头路的一条弄堂里。这个女孩渴望获得同性别的“知识”，这是她生活中唯一的乐趣。她对香蕉或人参（阴茎）毫无兴趣，从不关心感觉如何，对其漠不关心，就像对待一双草拖鞋一样。在阿九隔壁还住着另一个放荡的女孩，名叫老三，她是性交方面的行家，但她也不喜欢异性。自从这两个女孩相识以来，她们交往密切，如同夫妻。这两个女孩偶尔会租一间旅馆房间，彼此间进行荒淫活动，相互“搏斗”。她们在“搏斗”中使用匕首和刀（仿制阴茎），各种此类器具均由阿九提供。她们在“打斗”过程中兴奋不已，直到精疲力竭才停止。

一天，某个女孩因事拜访其中一人，当她进去打开卧室门时，发现她们两人都裸体躺在“搏斗”的高潮中。她们头发凌乱，身上溅满了“液体”，同时不停地喊叫“快乐，快乐”。客人进来时，两个女孩已到了气喘吁吁的阶段，所以虽然看到了她，却无法停止。客人随即退出，但她清楚地看到了这一秘密的淫秽行为。

"B"

The Movie & Dancing News ( 影舞新闻 ) published
the following article on November 26:-

A PROSTITUTE MARRIES A SODOMIST

A certain prostitute marries a person who is a
sodomist. Upon learning that her husband is a sodomist
the girl divorced him. This girl is very voluptuous.
Mr. Zee ( 徐 ), a friend of mine, knows all

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of Anonymous letter.

November 25, 193 5.

To
The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,
A publication entitled "The Yin Fu News", 20th edition, has come to the notice of the undersigned. It is not the intention of the writer to raise the question whether what has been recorded is authentic or not, but the language used is so indecent that it would seriously affect public morals if the same is allowed in circulation. A page is forwarded herewith for your information please.

(Signed): "Wang Liang Fah".

Translator's note:
The paragraph underlined by blue ink reports a female named Ah Chiu, allowing herself in sensuality, residing in Swatow Road, having associated with the company of a loose woman named Lao San, living next to her. Despite the fact that they are of the same sex, they love each other as married parties and sensualize by means of perversion. In very dirty language the report describes how the secret was performed and witnessed by a third party.

匿名信译文。

致
上海工部局警务处总监，
上海工部局。

先生：
一份题为《银福新闻》的第二十期出版物引起了下署人的注意。笔者无意就其所载内容之真伪提出问题，但其用语极为淫秽，若任其流传，将严重败坏社会风化。现随函附上一页，供阁下参阅。

（签名）：“王良发”（音译）。

译者注：
用蓝墨水划线的段落报道了一名名叫阿秋的女子，居住于汕头路，沉溺于淫乱行为，并与住在隔壁、名为老三的放荡女子交往。尽管二者均为女性，却如夫妻般相爱，并通过变态方式进行淫乱活动。该报道以极其污秽的语言描述了这一秘密行为的过程，并称有第三方目击。
